bugs.origin_evidence: isFloatingExempt's is_on_all_workspaces()/floatByRole check was added by OUR commit 86b82e7 (forge-yyum), NOT in upstream/main. Upstream isFloatingExempt (window.js:2775-2827) has no such check. Regression created by our fork.

bugs.title: Rare St.BoxLayout 'already disposed' in tab-teardown under fuzzer (forge-bomy/v2yz family)
bugs.oneliner: Rare St.BoxLayout already-disposed crash in tabbed tab-teardown under fuzzer (bomy/v2yz family)

bugs.title: use-after-dispose: _destroyDecoration leaves child .tab refs dangling → Gjs-CRITICAL crash on close in stacked/tabbed
bugs.oneliner: use-after-dispose: _destroyDecoration leaves child .tab dangling, crashing on close in stacked/tabbed
bugs.origin_evidence: _destroyDecoration (whose missing _resetTabForReparent loop creates dangling .tab refs) is absent from upstream/main tree.js (count=0). The reset/teardown machinery is a fork addition (a3f993f/2b01d6a).

bugs.title: tabbed/stacked tab actor double-parented on keyboard swap → Clutter assertion crashes shell
bugs.oneliner: Tabbed tab actor double-parented on keyboard swap, tripping a Clutter assertion that crashes shell
bugs.origin_evidence: swapPairs (no .tab detach) and the render guard `if (child.tab && !decoration.contains(child.tab))` exist identically in upstream tree.js:1181/1584; double-parent-on-swap condition predates fork. Upstream try/catch swallows the assertion; our decoration rewrite surfaced the crash.

bugs.origin_evidence: upstream focus() (tree.js:788) only raise/focus/activate — no make_above pin or _waylandStackingTimeoutId; the single shared Wayland stacking timer was added in our commit 19e00af, fixed in 3214290.

bugs.title: Shell crash: get_work_area_current_monitor abort on monitor-less window

bugs.title: WindowManager._kbd captured before Keybindings is constructed — allowDragDropTile() throws on every tiled-window drag, wedging the window in GRAB_TILE

bugs.origin_evidence: upstream get kbd() lazily constructs Keybindings (window.js:872-878) so an undefined snapshot self-heals; our refactor 19e00af removed the lazy init leaving `return this._kbd;`, which froze undefined. Fixed in 535ced5.
